scope: Unmodified ordinary daemon with fixed immutable per-generation quota policy is READY before a full owned L1 state-disk dm-error or suspend fault. Ledger, owners, runtime, assets and already-open FDs share that disk. Busy/idle EIO and held-I/O each run once; real L2 KVM/unprivileged UID, inherited extra quota filter/default VMM seccomp, capacity retention, physical stop and new execution refusal checked separately.
mapped_observer_boundary: Only own L1 PID1 can observe the four fixed driver projects. Mapping must be the object created by this PID1, exact active linear table/device/name/backing /dev/vda read back, exact block-node identity and rw ext4 prjquota mount/format checked. No caller-selected device/table/project, no L0 mapper/mount/module/capability changes.
before_fault_baseline: Private staged assets, project accounting and receipt are synchronized; Syncfs establishes a READY-state whole-filesystem baseline. This deliberately does not test crashes between quota-attempt/Q_SET/Q_SYNC/private staging.
eio_scope: Actual pre-opened O_DIRECT read returns EIO. DELETE returns500, durable record remains STOPPING without stop/destroy timestamps, new exec409 and new create503. Exact quota owner bytes remain after the mapper is linear again; after cold boot, independent named-inode charge and immutable limits/attrs/asset hashes checked before ordinary recovery, old key410 and fresh real KVM exec/destroy, all four private project records zero.
eio_pid_baseline: Both EIO cases retain the synchronized non-authoritative PID file content: before/after charge189911040 bytes,16 host inodes. Recovery does not consult saved PID bytes. This is not the old unsynchronized running-cold case, whose valid4KiB drop remains separately regressed.
held_io_scope: Pre-opened direct read blocks and an actual ordinary-daemon thread is observed D in fsync/fdatasync of /srv/state. No DELETE acknowledgment while held; capacity remains503 and host execution stop/new exec refusal are independently observed. Resume linear I/O, then observe durable DESTROYED, exact resources absent and all four quota records zero before cold boot.
held_io_flag_interpretation: quota_and_ownership_released_only_after_io_resumed records zero/owner-absence confirmation after resume together with held-fsync/no-ACK/capacity-retention evidence. The fixture does not issue an independent quota read while the device is suspended; it is not standalone proof of every intermediate quota syscall state.
